news.title: 11Alive helps with arrest of man allegedly stealing HVAC units in DeKalb County
news.summary: According to DeKalb County arrest warrants, Christian Ikechukwu Oji, was caught on video stealing HVAC units from a woman's home on two separate occasions.

news.title: Stacey Humphreys requests execution stay under state law
news.summary: A death row inmate scheduled for execution this week petitioned a Cobb County court to halt his lethal injection and reduce his sentence under a new state law.

news.title: Murder suspect in another state captured in metro Atlanta
news.summary: The Cobb County Police Department said they helped arrest a man from Tennessee on Sept. 9. Now he’s waiting in jail before being extradited to face a murder charge.

news.title: Schools investigate racism claims after Jefferson-Jackson game
news.summary: Atlanta Public Schools and Jefferson City Schools are investigating after allegations of racist behavior surfaced following a high school football game Friday night.

news.title: Young man placing construction flags killed on Lavista Road
news.summary: A 19-year-old male was struck and killed Monday morning in DeKalb County.

news.title: Worker killed in incident at Global Industrial facility identified
news.summary: A 56-year-old worker died Sept. 9 after becoming trapped between a loading ramp and a truck at a Global Industrial warehouse in Buford.

news.title: Georgia death row inmate appeals to Supreme Court ahead of execution
news.summary: Cobb County convicted murderer Stacey Humphreys continues fighting in court to delay or cancel his pending execution.

news.title: Woman rams into car, pulls gun after being honked at
news.summary: Gwinnett County police are looking for a woman in connection to a road rage incident involving multiple shots fired at another driver.

news.title: Woman wanted for alleged road-rage shooting in Gwinnett County, police say
news.summary: Gwinnett County police seek Sierra Iman Little, 23, accused of aggravated assault and firing shots in a road-rage incident.

news.title: Woman wanted after shots fired in Gwinnett road rage case
news.summary: Gwinnett County police are searching for 23-year-old Sierra Iman Little after a road rage incident Sept. 7.

news.title: Man arrested more than two months after triple shooting in northwest Atlanta
news.summary: The shooting injured three siblings and happened in the Joseph E. Boulevard NW location in Atlanta on July 5.
